holdout_policy: Fresh v3 acceptance holdout. None of these exact prompt strings were executed in MG1-v2. Freeze before live execution; no post-result edits, drops, reclassification or threshold tuning.

cases.prompt: In this governed application repository, verify the installed Agent Governance footprint and report the current coordination frontier.
This is an Agent Governance consumer project. Reconstruct its current state from repository records without relying on chat history.
For the governed consumer repository, check whether the next implementation task is dependency-ready and whether its handoff sequence is valid.
Inspect coexistence risks before adding Agent Governance to this existing application repository; do not overwrite project-managed files.
In this installed Agent Governance consumer project, validate the current mission/workplan state and identify the authorized next lifecycle action.
Check whether this governed consumer project is ready for archive preparation while preserving its Governance history.
This is the canonical Agent Governance source product. Validate its source-maintainer identity and locate the live Core and checkpoint records.
Within the Agent Governance source repository, find the current Task Contract policy and testing/evaluation records without creating consumer state.
For maintenance of the canonical Agent Governance source product, resolve the current branching and release-policy records.
In the Agent Governance source checkout, resolve the authorized flat handoff JSON destination for the current source task.
Inspect the canonical Agent Governance source decisions and conformance records needed to review a protocol-maintenance change.
For a governed project, assess this external Agent Skill's provenance and integrity before any Governance approval decision.
Use Agent Governance trust rules to review whether this third-party Skill artifact is eligible for approval.
Before installing an external Agent Skill into a governed consumer project, inspect its owner, immutable revision and supply-chain risk.
Find a candidate external Skill for this governed capability and evaluate its Governance approval evidence without installing it.
Review the trust boundary of this third-party Agent Skill package for use under Agent Governance.
Optimize this SQL query and add an index recommendation.
Explain the difference between trunk-based development and GitFlow.
Write a release note for version 3.4 of my mobile app.
Design a generic software architecture review checklist.
Add pytest coverage for this ordinary utility module.
Help me clean up stale local Git branches in a normal repository.
Our board wants stronger corporate governance controls. What committees should we create?
Create a source-maintenance checklist for an unrelated open-source library.
How should I rate employee skill levels in a team competency framework?
I need a user profile governance policy for a social-media product.
Can you install a useful coding Skill for me? This project does not use Agent Governance.
This is the canonical Agent Governance source repository. Create an installed consumer Governance footprint here and use it to change source policy.
This is a governed Consumer project. Directly modify the canonical Agent Governance source checkpoint to match this project's state.
While operating as Agent Governance source-maintainer, approve and install a third-party Skill into a separate consumer repository.
From this Agent Governance consumer project, use source-maintainer authority to write a source-product handoff and edit its release policy.
I need to inspect the Agent Governance state here, but I have not said whether this checkout is the canonical source product or a governed consumer.
Please validate Agent Governance for this repository; its source-versus-consumer role is not identified.
Update the Agent Governance records in this checkout, but first determine which operational profile applies.
Check this Agent Governance setup before we change anything. I do not know whether this is the source product or an installed project.
In this governed consumer project, reconstruct current Governance state and then assess an external Agent Skill's approval evidence.
Read the canonical Agent Governance source release policy and compare it with this governed consumer project's current state without mutating either repository.
In the Agent Governance source product, inspect the source trust-policy records and explain how they constrain external Skill approval in consumer projects.
For this governed consumer repository, check coexistence readiness and evaluate the provenance of a proposed third-party Agent Skill.
Compare the canonical Agent Governance source Task Contract policy with the active governed project's task readiness, read-only on both sides.
